unexpected.title: OXESpace hit an unexpected error
unexpected.message: Something went wrong in the background.
unexpected.detail: Your terminals and agents may still be running, but OXESpace can no longer guarantee them. Restart to continue safely. Diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.

rendererGone.title: OXESpace stopped responding
rendererGone.detail: Your terminals and agents are still running. Restart OXESpace to bring the interface back; diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.

queue.deliveryUnconfirmed: Delivery of this message could not be confirmed.

dashboard.timeout: The dashboard did not respond in time.

network.notFound: The host name was not found. Check the URL and the connection.
network.refused: The connection was refused: nothing is listening at that address and port.
network.reset: The server closed the connection before answering.

approvals.unavailable: The approval could not be shown in the app, so it opened in a system dialog.
approvals.expired: Nobody answered in time, so the request was denied.

refused.notPending: This request was already answered, cancelled or expired.
refused.staleGeneration: This request was asked again since it was shown. Answer the current one.
refused.alreadyAnswered: This request already has an answer.
refused.unknownOption: That answer is not one of the options this request offers.
refused.alreadyReported: This request was already reported as not shown.
refused.tooSoon: Wait a moment: this request is risky, so Allow is available two seconds after it appears.

denied.queueFull: Too many requests are waiting ({{max}}), so this one was denied without being shown.
denied.tooLong: The text to approve is longer than {{max}} characters, more than a person can review, so it was refused. Split it into smaller steps.

refused.reservedName: A notification cannot use the name "{{name}}"; it belongs to the app.
refused.rateLimit: Too many notifications: at most {{perMinute}} a minute.

name.reserved: A pane cannot be named after "{{name}}"; that name belongs to the app.
